displayName: 创建工作台 13 张业务表
sql:
CREATE TABLE app.ast (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  owner text NOT NULL,
  rid text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  coins text,
  total_earned text,
  total_spent text,
  total_claims text,
  monthly_earned text,
  monthly_spent text,
  today_earned text,
  today_spent text,
  last_active text,
  created_on text,
  cabin_theme text,
  daily_reset boolean,
  notifications boolean,
  pet_remind boolean,
  today_words text,
  today_words_date text,
  today_video_idx text,
  today_video_date text
);
CREATE INDEX ast_owner_rid_idx ON app.ast (owner, rid);
CREATE TABLE app.meal (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  owner text NOT NULL,
  rid text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  log_date text,
  meal text,

  calories text,

  image text

CREATE INDEX meal_owner_rid_idx ON app.meal (owner, rid);
